verses.text: Now while Ezra dey pray and confess, dey cry and lie down before God house, very big gathering of men, women and pikin dem gather to am from Israel, because di people cry bitterly.

Shecaniah, Jehiel pikin, one of di sons of Elam, talk to Ezra say, “We don do wrong against our God and marry strange women from di peoples of di land. But even now hope dey for Israel about dis thing.

So now make we make covenant with our God to send away all di wives and dem wey dem born, according to di advice of my lord and of dem wey dey tremble at di command of our God, and make dem do am according to di law.
Stand up, because dis matter na your own, and we dey with you. Be strong and do am.”
Den Ezra stand up and make di chiefs of di priests, di Levites and all Israel swear say dem go do according to dis word. So dem swear.

Den Ezra stand up from before God house and go di room of Jehohanan, Eliashib pikin. When e reach there, e no eat bread and e no drink water, because e dey mourn di wrong of di people of di prisoner land.
Dem send word through Judah and Jerusalem to all di pikin dem of di prisoner land say make dem gather together for Jerusalem,
and say anybody wey no come inside three days, according to di advice of di princes and di elders, dem go take all im property and separate am from di gathering of di people of di prisoner land.

Den all di men of Judah and Benjamin gather together for Jerusalem inside di three days. Na di ninth month, for di twentieth day of di month. All di people sit for di open place before God house, dey tremble because of dis matter and because of di big rain.
Ezra di priest stand up and talk to dem say, “You don do wrong and marry strange women, to add to di guilt of Israel.
So now confess to di Lord, di God of una papa dem, and do wetin e want. Separate una self from di peoples of di land and from di strange women.”
Den all di gathering answer with loud voice say, “As you don talk about us, so we must do.
But di people plenty, and na time of plenty rain, and we no fit stand outside. Dis work no be one day or two, because we don do wrong well well for dis matter.

Make dem appoint our princes for all di gathering, and make all dem wey don marry strange women for our cities come for set times, and di elders of every city and di judges of am go with dem, until di hot anger of our God for dis matter turn away from us.”
Only Jonathan, Asahel pikin, and Jahzeiah, Tikvah pikin, stand against dis matter, and Meshullam and Shabbethai di Levite help dem.

Di pikin dem of di prisoner land do so. Ezra di priest and some heads of papa houses, by dem papa houses, all of dem by name, dem separate dem, and dem sit down for di first day of di tenth month to look into di matter.
By di first day of di first month, dem finish with all di men wey don marry strange women.
Among di sons of di priests wey marry strange women, dem find of di sons of Jeshua, Jozadak pikin, and im brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib and Gedaliah.
Dem give dem hand say dem go send away dem wives, and because dem get guilt, dem offer ram from di flock for dem wrong.
Of di sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.
Of di sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel and Uzziah.
Of di sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad and Elasah.
Of di Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah, wey dem also call Kelita, Pethahiah, Judah and Eliezer.
Of di singers: Eliashib. Of di gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem and Uri.
Of Israel: of di sons of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah and Benaiah.
Of di sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth and Elijah.
Of di sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad and Aziza.
Of di sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai and Athlai.
Of di sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal and Jeremoth.
Of di sons of Pahath Moab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui and Manasseh.
Of di sons of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
Benjamin, Malluch and Shemariah.
Of di sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh and Shimei.
Of di sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,
Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,
Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
Mattaniah, Mattenai and Jaasu,
Bani, Binnui, Shimei,
Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,
Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,
Shallum, Amariah and Joseph.
Of di sons of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel and Benaiah.
All dis ones don marry strange wives, and some of dem get wives wey don born pikin for dem.
